name: v27-d-04-health-center
objective: v2.7 04 live (D) complete fixture, no model. A group story whose requirements name a member with no card, played with no memory model and Summarize on. Player mode, drawer Overview: the Setup section lists memory-model and cast-absent (blocks, the Before you start rows at boundary 0) before transcript-copiers (degrades), every blocks row before every degrades row and info after both; blocks rows have no dismiss control, the degrades row has one; the HUD #so-hud-setup counts equal the rendered blocks/degrades rows (info and the save row never counted). Show me on the memory-model row lands on #so-extraction-profile. Author view adds the detail. With a seeded held secret the player rows read the same. A stored dismissal of memory-model (blocks) is ignored. Dismissing transcript-copiers moves it to the dismissed list, drops the HUD degrades count by one, and survives a reload. No toast carries a check's copy. Solo control: a one-on-one chat holding the story shows only story-needs-group. Not expressed: the one-click fixes (cast-unbound / cast-muted would edit the shared toy group's member list; covered by castRepair jest and the make-a-group card in v27-03-no-group-solo-blob.json). Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-d-04-health-center.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" (a no-model lane: st-lanes.mts no-model <n>).

requires.why: no memory model is part of the fixture; the held secret is planted through applyExtractionAudit; Summarize is an ext_setting the runner restores; a model would only add reads the fixture does not measure

[]; const off = ['memory', 'vectors'].filter((name) => disabled.includes(name)); if (off.length) throw new Error(`needs SillyTavern's ${off.join(' and ')} extension enabled on this lane (disabledExtensions lists it), or the copier read can never fire`); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const settings = rt.getGlobalSettings(); sessionStorage.setItem('v27d04', JSON.stringify({ dismissed: settings.help.dismissedChecks ?? [], capable: settings.memory.epistemicLedgerCapable === true })); return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('v27d04'));
